name: nk-explorer
description: Turn one formula into a self-contained offline HTML explorer with the person's question, a headline answer with its unit, one principal slider and a curve, expandable formula working and other settings, and practice graded on the result.

interface.longDescription: Turn one formula into a self-contained offline HTML explorer with the person's question, a headline answer with its unit, one principal slider and a curve, expandable formula working and other settings, and practice graded on the result. Use when lessons, posts or README examples need to show how a formula behaves by changing its inputs. Build from JSON with scripts/make_explorer.py, validate with scripts/explorer_check.py, and use scripts/probe_check.py for Chrome interaction checks. One formula and sliders only; no systems of equations or table queries.
